Title: Preflight inventory and reconciliation
User story / technical objective: Before writing code, inventory what exists so IADM-08 reuses shared audit and health endpoints and duplicates nothing.
Acceptance criteria: One-page report covering: branch and working-tree; conventions of IADM-01..07 (port, route, keys, migration style, read-recording, IADM-05 gate); next free port after 8105 and route collision vs legacy /api/v1/admin; legacy adm08.* keys disposition; shared audit log_event/events including denial-event presence; IADM-07 alerts read endpoint; auditor scope assignment; health target inventory method; notification service; demo personas; DEV DB confirmation. Missing items written TBC.
Blueprint / decision ref: D2 (shared audit query), D5 (health inventory), D10 (IADM-07 alerts), D12 (port/route), D13 (keys/actions), D17 (reuse personas/audit)
Build default or status: Read-only; no code or DB change

Title: IADM-08 service scaffold
User story / technical objective: Create IADM-08 as a separate deployable Java service following preflight conventions.
Acceptance criteria: Service starts; health endpoint answers; gateway route registered with no collision; exception handling and structured logging; no sensitive payload in logs; technical doc started. Port 8106 and route /api/v1/iadm/08 reported.

Title: Permission keys and role mapping
User story / technical objective: Define iadm08.* permission keys and map them to R01 (Super Admin), R02 (System Admin), R03 (Institution Admin), R28 (Auditor); R04 (College Admin) denied; manage key reserved.
Acceptance criteria: Keys: iadm08.audit.platform.view (platform-wide audit view), iadm08.audit.institute.view (own-institute audit view), iadm08.health.view (service health view), iadm08.alerts.view (read-only alerts view), iadm08.manage (reserved not granted). R01/R02 view/investigate platform audit and health; R03 own-institute audit only no health; R28 read-only audit/health/alerts no export; R04 none. No wildcard. Legacy adm08.* untouched. Offline matrix + denial tests.

Title: Additive permission-key migration
User story / technical objective: Apply one numbered reversible additive migration for IADM-08 permission keys and grants on DEV only.
Acceptance criteria: Migration inserts iadm08.* into shared catalogue and role templates/grants. No schema, no table, no RLS change beyond catalogue. Rollback script. Before/after inventory. Target verified DEV azulbaxszsqxymqmlwfe only.

Title: Shared audit read and fail-closed read recording
User story / technical objective: Wire DurableAuditWriter and audit.events read; every IADM-08 read records filter summary only.
Acceptance criteria: audit.log_event used for IADM08_* read events (IADM08_AUDIT_SEARCH, IADM08_AUDIT_DETAIL, IADM08_AUDIT_TIMELINE, IADM08_HEALTH_OVERVIEW, IADM08_HEALTH_DETAIL, IADM08_ALERTS_READ); if recording fails request refused (503 IADM08_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE). audit.events queried with trusted scope. No second audit store. Never insert fabricated audit rows for demo.
Blueprint / decision ref: D2 (shared audit query), D3 (fail-closed read recording)

Title: Query limits, safe fields and IADM-05 policy client
User story / technical objective: Enforce mandatory time range, max window reject-not-truncate, page size, safe field projection, and IADM-05 gate.
Acceptance criteria: DEMO ONLY defaults 31 days and 50 rows configurable at runtime and reported. Fields returned: eventId, eventTime, actor, action, target, outcome, correlationId, institute only. Exactly one published IADM-05 policy for OPERATIONS domain or withhold.
Blueprint / decision ref: D4 (limits & policy gate), D15 (IADM-05 OPERATIONS policy)

Title: Demo readiness — reuse existing audit entries
User story / technical objective: Ensure desks show real shared-audit entries from prior headed runs without inserting into shared audit.
Acceptance criteria: At least two institutes represented where existing events exist. Personas reuse R01 (Super Admin), R02 (System Admin), R03 (Institution Admin), R04 (College Admin), R28 (Auditor). No invented emails/IDs. No shared-audit inserts.

Title: Search platform audit records
User story / technical objective: As R01 (Super Admin) / R02 (System Admin) I can search authorized platform audit records within a bounded time range.
Acceptance criteria: Bounded search of audit.events; mandatory time range; over-max rejected (400 IADM08_RANGE_TOO_LARGE); read recorded (IADM08_AUDIT_SEARCH); safe fields only; unauthorized denied.
Blueprint / decision ref: D2 (shared audit query), D3 (fail-closed read recording), D4 (limits & policy gate)

Title: Audit event detail
User story / technical objective: As R01 (Super Admin) / R02 (System Admin) I can inspect one audit event by id with safe fields only and no mutation.
Acceptance criteria: Detail endpoint; read recorded (IADM08_AUDIT_DETAIL); no edit/delete; missing id 404 (IADM08_NOT_FOUND); unauthorized 403.
Blueprint / decision ref: D2 (shared audit query), D3 (fail-closed read recording)

Title: Administrator activity timeline
User story / technical objective: As R01 (Super Admin) / R02 (System Admin) I can view source-recorded activity for a permitted actor.
Acceptance criteria: Timeline from audit.events by principal; trusted scope; read recorded (IADM08_AUDIT_TIMELINE); safe fields.
Blueprint / decision ref: D2 (shared audit query), D3 (fail-closed read recording)

Title: Institution own-institute activity
User story / technical objective: As R03 (Institution Admin) I can view only my institute's attributed audit activity.
Acceptance criteria: Own-institute filter from trusted context; unattributed events hidden; cross-institute denied (403 IADM08_SCOPE_DENIED); no health view.

Title: Auditor investigation
User story / technical objective: As R28 (Auditor) I can read permitted audit evidence platform-wide (no active audit-scope assignment found).
Acceptance criteria: Read-only; no mutation; no export; platform-wide default per preflight; read recorded (IADM08_AUDIT_SEARCH).
Named evidence: docs/iadm/iadm-08/evidence/us023/R28_desk.png + R28_audit_detail.png + R28_alerts.png + R28_export_denied.png + audit row e465b76d-0a63-46be-9480-c9702f3ae072

Title: Health target inventory (server-side)
User story / technical objective: Enumerate health targets only from server-side configuration or gateway route registry.
Acceptance criteria: Never call client-supplied address (400 IADM08_TARGET_REJECTED). Minimal labelled in-service list (gateway + IADM-01..08) documented.

Title: Service health overview
User story / technical objective: As R01 (Super Admin) / R02 (System Admin) I can read built-service and gateway health on request.
Acceptance criteria: On-request aggregation; nothing stored; status mapping D6; read recorded (IADM08_HEALTH_OVERVIEW); R03 (Institution Admin) denied.
Blueprint / decision ref: D5 (health inventory), D6 (status mapping), D3 (fail-closed read recording)

Title: Service health detail
User story / technical objective: As R01 (Super Admin) / R02 (System Admin) I can inspect health detail for one verified target.
Acceptance criteria: Target id from inventory only; Unavailable/Unknown never Healthy/zero; read recorded (IADM08_HEALTH_DETAIL).

Actor / role: R01 (Super Admin) / R02 (System Admin) / R03 (Institution Admin) / R28 (Auditor)
Title: Operational alerts
User story / technical objective: As authorized roles I can view operational alerts read-only; IADM-07 security alerts via IADM-07 GET /alerts with trusted scope.
Acceptance criteria: No acknowledge; no local alert state; read recorded (IADM08_ALERTS_READ).

Title: IADM-07 evidence linkage
User story / technical objective: As these roles I can link to related IADM-07 evidence when the read contract exists.
Acceptance criteria: Read-only links/refs; IADM-07 remains owner; no duplicate registers.

Title: SLA / availability not available
User story / technical objective: Show an honest not-available placeholder; no SLA/uptime value.
Acceptance criteria: SLA section text only 'not available'; no fabricated metrics.

Title: Alert acknowledgement absence
User story / technical objective: Verify no acknowledge feature, endpoint or control exists; attempts refused.
Acceptance criteria: No POST/PATCH acknowledge route; UI has no ack control; attempts return 404 IADM08_NOT_AVAILABLE.

Title: Export absence
User story / technical objective: Verify no export feature, endpoint or key exists; attempts refused.
Acceptance criteria: No export key; no export endpoint; R28 (Auditor) and others cannot export (404 IADM08_NOT_AVAILABLE).

Title: Deferred-feature and denial-event verification
User story / technical objective: Automated/contract checks that deferred features are absent and denial events display only if present in shared audit.
Acceptance criteria: US-010/011/015 absences verified by test. Denial events shown only when matching shared-audit rows exist (4 existing IADM02_*_DENIED rows). Never create denial events.
Depends on: IADM-08-US-010 (Ack absence), IADM-08-US-011 (SLA placeholder), IADM-08-US-015 (Export absence)

Title: Access-denial and isolation tests
User story / technical objective: Verify R04 (College Admin) denial, R03 (Institution Admin) institute isolation and R28 (Auditor) read-only scope.
Acceptance criteria: Automated + headed evidence for deny/isolation.

Title: Source-failure handling
User story / technical objective: Demonstrate unavailable/unknown/partial and read-audit failure refusal.
Acceptance criteria: Stopped DEV service -> Unavailable; silent/delayed target -> Unknown; recovery -> Healthy; read recording failure -> 503 IADM08_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE.

Title: Evidence pack and close-out
User story / technical objective: Prove the work is done the way the owner defined done.
Acceptance criteria: Final report table of 24 rows with target vs ACTUAL; headed film (25/25 PASS); permission before/after; D1-D18; no IADM-08 schema; git status local commits not pushed.
